caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt composed of four large square blocks arranged in a 2x2 grid, each with a star pattern in the center. The blocks are colored with various patterns and shades, primarily featuring red, blue, beige, brown, and white, with some green on the sashing between the lower blocks. The top left block has a blue gingham background with a star made of red triangles, brown rectangles with patterns, and a white square with black lines and star-like motifs in the center. The top right block has a blue, red, black, white, and yellow color scheme, with red and white stripes, black and white checkers, yellow patterned sections, and a light center square with a butterfly pattern. The bottom left block has beige sections with black lines and small star shapes, brown patterned corners, and red triangles with white dots. The bottom right block includes a red border, brown patterned sections, and a white background with red and green floral and linear designs. The individual blocks are separated by strips of blue, beige, yellow, black, white, and green patterned fabric, and the overall quilt is outlined with a red edge. The artist's name, "ROSE CAMPBELL GERKE," is written in small letters in the lower left corner of the image. The drawing is rendered with fine linework and watercolor shading to show texture and the appearance of stitching.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
